messages:
sasha: FYI the preview build failed on linkcheck for the migration guide. I see a mismatch for an MDX heading -> anchor slug, and a couple of list-item wrapped headings that lose their slug when rendered.

oliver: ugh. which page? can you paste the failing lines from the CI job?

sasha: /guides/migration.md. Linkcheck says: 1) expected fragment '#quantization-tips' but target generated '#quantizationtips' 2) several in-page links to 'legacy-embed' 404 in the versioned site. CI output:```
Linkcheck: Broken fragment(s) found:
 - /guides/migration.md -> #quantization-tips (generated: #quantizationtips)
 - /sdk/embeddings.md -> #legacy-embed (404)
```

maria: I think we saw the quantization heading as a list item under a subheading, e.g. '\n- Quantization tips\n' under 'Performance tweaks' which MDX/docusaurus turns into slugs differently. Can we edit to make it an explicit h3?

devon: If it's MDX/MkDocs parity issue, maybe the rendering changes between the two toolchains. We should prefer explicit header syntax (###) for anything we link to. Quick patch: replace the bullet with a heading and re-run linkcheck.

sasha: Agreed. I'll open a tiny docs PR to replace the list item with a proper header and update the anchor in the in-page links. Also I'll add a short note in the migration guide about heading-to-slug pitfalls.

oliver: Please also grep the repo for '#quantization-tips' and '#quantizationtips' to find other occurrences. Could be mismatch in older versions.

maria: I'll handle the embeddings link — seems like the anchor was renamed when we split the page. I'll add a redirect in the MKDocs redirects map for /sdk/embeddings.md#legacy-embed -> /sdk/embeddings.md#embedding-compatibility.

docs-bot: linkcheck report uploaded: https://ci.redwood/links/1744554321/report — 2 failures (now suppressed after branch patch).

devon: Small nit — when you update the heading, include an explicit HTML id on the heading in MDX so both renderers yield the same fragment, e.g.:
```
### Quantization tips {#quantization-tips}
```

sasha: Good call. I'll do that in the PR along with the link updates and a one-line test in docs/tests/link_snippets.test.md that references the fragment. Trying to keep the PR < 10 lines.

oliver: Awesome. Ping here once the PR is up and CI reruns. :thumbsup:

sasha: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1248 — contains: converted list to h3, explicit id, updated internal links, redirects map entry. Rerunning linkcheck.

docs-bot: CI linkcheck passed on patch (0 broken fragments).

maria: Nice! leaving a small follow-up to tighten the wording in the new subsection.

oliver: Thanks everyone. We'll add a short note to the contributor guide about avoiding list-item headings when they are targets for links.

sasha: Added that to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md in the PR. Closing thread once change is merged.

(threads like this can be terse — logging here so the fix is traceable)
